tool_schemas.name: get_events
tool_schemas.description: Searches the event listings for records matching the provided keywords and returns up to `limit` results (default 10); results are limited rather than paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `keywords` is missing/empty or if `limit` is not a positive integer. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to query events and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the service rejects the request due to query-usage limits.

tool_schemas.name: get_event
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single event by `id`. Returns the event record when found. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such event exists and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the event.

tool_schemas.name: list_ingestion_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingestion jobs in reverse chronological order with optional status and source filtering. Returns a page of jobs and a cursor for the next page when available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view ingestion jobs.

status.description: Filter ingestion jobs by lifecycle status.

source_name.description: Filter jobs by source name (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_ingestion_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single ingestion job by `id`. Returns the job record including status and counters. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such job exists and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view ingestion jobs.

tool_schemas.name: create_ingestion_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates an ingestion job to ingest/upsert events from an external CFP source. Returns the created job in `queued` status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid input and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to create ingestion jobs.

source_url.description: The URL or feed endpoint to ingest from.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_ingestion_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an ingestion job by `id`. Permitted only when the job is `queued` or `running`; transitions the job to `cancelled` when accepted. Returns the updated job. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such job exists, CONFLICT if the job cannot be cancelled from its current state, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to cancel ingestion jobs.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the caller identity and current entitlements for this service, including API key status (when applicable), granted scopes, and current UTC-day query usage versus quota. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot be identified.

api_key.description: Optional API key presented to the service; when provided it is validated and reflected in the response.
